sources.title: NSIP: Advice on the Preparation and Submission of Application Documents
sources.verified_claim: Planning Inspectorate guidance sets requirements for application documents, plans, draft DCOs, Environmental Statements and related material; a generic process page does not identify candidate land.

sources.title: NSIP: Advice on Preparing Applications for Linear Projects
sources.verified_claim: Current advice for linear DCO projects covers project location, design evolution, construction effects and land rights; exact order limits remain necessary for candidate linkage.

sources.title: NSIP: Advice on EIA Notification and Consultation
sources.verified_claim: The Planning Inspectorate describes EIA notification and consultation for NSIPs and prescribed bodies; this is process context rather than parcel evidence.

sources.title: Planning Act 2008: Guidance on the acceptance stage of an application
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The 2026 acceptance guidance explains statutory requirements and acceptance decisions for DCO applications; acceptance does not prove a candidate lies within order limits.

sources.title: Planning Act 2008: Guidance on the decision-making stage of an application
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Current decision-stage guidance covers Secretary of State decision making and legal challenge/redetermination; candidate impact depends on the specific DCO and plans.

sources.title: NSIP: Advice for Local Authorities
sources.verified_claim: Planning Inspectorate advice explains local-authority participation throughout the NSIP process and reinforces that project-specific evidence and representations are required.

sources.title: NSIP: information about interests in land under section 52
sources.verified_claim: Section 52 advice concerns obtaining information about land interests that could be affected by a DCO; an actual notice or order-plan match is needed for candidate evidence.

sources.title: NSIP: rights of entry to land under section 53
sources.verified_claim: Current section 53 advice covers rights to enter potentially affected land for surveys; it is not evidence that a sample candidate is affected unless the project and land are matched.
